conventions.frames: frame_start..frame_end inclusive at 30 fps; duration = (frame_end - frame_start) / 30; loops repeat their first pose on the last frame
conventions.poses: static entries are exported as two identical frames (duration 1/30 s) so they import as ordinary pose clips
conventions.travel_dir_deg: 0 = forward, +90 = character left, measured counter-clockwise seen from above
conventions.aim: yaw + = towards the character left, pitch + = up; grid yaw -60/0/+60, pitch -35/0/+35
conventions.events: event frames are clip-local; Unreal notifies are created from this list at import
conventions.prop_tracks: frames during which a prop bone is carried by another bone than its rest parent (holder = bone name, or "world" = stays where it was released, in root space)
conventions.floor_contact: clips whose hands / knees / torso rest on the floor: play them without foot IK or additive layers
conventions.source_keys: sparse = hand keyed poses on the control rig; dense = one key per frame on the control rig (floor-constrained or simulated channels)
conventions.qa: measured on the baked skeleton: loop_error (max joint channel difference between first and last frame), slide_max_cm_s (planted foot speed relative to the ground speed), min_sole_height_cm, body_clear_cm
